newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums stay easy in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums stay easy in thin trade.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices were weaker on Thursday in line with benchmark gas oil futures and with barge and cargo premiums easing, traders sad.

Some traders expected to see additional cargo avails as a result of the British Airways strike although most were optimistic that tighter gas oil and diesel supplies in ARA could draw some extra demand from blenders.

This sentiment however was not reflected in barge and cargo premiums to the gas oil screen. Barges were pegged around 50 cents lower at August IPE +$14/15 a tonne fob ARA with cargoes valued 75 cents to $1 lower at August IPE +$15 a tonne cif NWE.
At 1222 GMT benchmark August IPE gas oil futures were around $1 a tonne lower firmer at $162.25. The July contract expired at noon $1.25 down at $161.25 a tonne.
